mathematical_definition: Numba kernel avg_run_length(sign1, window=60): over the trailing 60 bars of sign(ret_1), the AVERAGE consecutive same-sign run length (total run-length mass / number of distinct runs) -- how persistent directionality has been on average, not just the current run
missing_value_policy: NaN for the first 60 bars (kernel loop starts at window=60); also NaN whenever the trailing window contains zero runs (all-flat segment), never zero-filled
